subject: Paper accepted — {{submissionNumber}} | {{conferenceName}}
headline: Manuscript accepted for presentation
paragraphs: We are pleased to inform you that your manuscript has been accepted for presentation at {{conferenceName}}, scheduled to be held online from 15–17 December 2026.
extraParagraphs: For all accepted manuscripts, at least one author must register for the conference to present the paper and ensure its further consideration for inclusion in the conference proceedings.
For registration and further details, kindly log in to your account using the link provided below:
afterCtaParagraphs: If the above link does not open directly, please copy and paste it into your web browser. Alternatively, you may access your account through the Registration tab on the conference website.
If you encounter any difficulty accessing your account or retrieving your details, please feel free to reply to this email. We will be happy to assist you.
Further details regarding the presentation schedule and other relevant instructions will be communicated to you in due course.
We look forward to your active participation in {{conferenceName}}.
